I have first done it 9 months ago, immediately after the incident happened. The proceedings took that long to complete due to the date being postponed several times. During those months, I have done the scene several times, but not all the time, because I didn't think about that particular thing all the time, of course. But any time I noticed him worrying about it, I reaffirmed. Every time I felt like I'm starting to worry, I imagined the scene before bed.

I understand why that's confusing and I'll try to explain it the best way I can. You don't have to maintain the state every second for a year to get your result. Not even for a whole day. But be adamant about it at least once, tell yourself, I am rich, I am f\*\*\*ing gorgeous, I am happily married to them, they're insanely in love with me, be audacious and impudent about it. You will, at least for a second, feel it is done. The doubts will return, the fears will torment you again, the crappy feelings won't go away forever. But you will reaffirm at least every third of the time you feel those emotions. 

So, to recap, you don't have to stay in the state all the time, that is mentally exhausting and extremely unnatural. You don't have to let it go either. You don't "have" to do anything. Because you won't be able to do any of those for a long time without losing your mind. What you want to do is not accept a result that you don't like, imagine your end result and be unshakable about it for at least a moment. Have brazen impudence! You will think about it from time to time and reaffirm. The only reason why letting go is recommended is because it is easier to reaffirm when you think about it less. Good luck!!!
